name: Marissa Posner
description: Currently, Marissa is Head of Product at Eureka, the third largest block builder. Previously, she worked at the Ethereum Foundation, where she led product work across account abstraction and interoperability. She co-authored the Trustless Manifesto with Vitalik Buterin and Yoav Weiss, articulating a vision for systems built around minimized trust and stronger decentralization.
